notes: Drop-target sense check on fresh isolated state. Four balls in the trough (36-39 at 1) and the left ramp down (47); two coins buy a credit and Start begins a game, which resets both drop banks once. The served ball leaves the trough (39 to 0) and passes the shooter lane (43). Then all seven targets stay at 0 for an 8 s control window, one KING target alone goes to public 1 and back as a control, all four KING targets (25-28) go to 1 and back to 0, and all three PIN targets (29-31) go to 1 and back to 0. The ROM fires the KING reset coil 6 or the PIN reset coil 7 when it reads a whole bank down, so the level that draws a reset is the level the ROM reads as a target down.
